reasons: Both prompts are paste-ready Russian prompts that get order data from get_order, check the remaining amount and existing refunds, enforce the delivered and 14-day rules, and send email only after a successful refund. B handles tool failure more robustly: it forbids retrying issue_refund after an error or unclear response and re-checks get_order to see whether the refund went through. It also covers an empty delivery date or email and includes a refusal example so the model does not learn to always refund. A is equally correct and handles session-based email and ownership well, but its error handling is thinner and its duplicate check is only a general rule.
